records.explanation: Qxc4 dropped your Win% from 21 to 14. In Stockfish's lines, Qd1 (-4.1) wins a pawn; your Qxc4 (-5.1) wins a knight. Qd1 ends with less material, so what it gains is in the position, which only Stockfish's score measures. Qd1 moves the queen on c2 out of attack, pins the knight on d4 to the queen on d8 and protects the pawn on f3. Your Qxc4 takes the pawn on c4 and moves the queen on c2 out of attack; Stockfish answers Nxf3+, which takes the pawn on f3 and gives check.
